decisions_not_to_reverse: Live GitHub issues/contracts remain Time to Crawl authority; conversational memory and stored snapshots do not override them.
Internet content remains untrusted data and cannot grant capabilities or tool authority.
Crawler engines remain replaceable execution dependencies behind CrawlerEnginePort; policy authority remains outside them.
A bespoke generic crawler remains forbidden unless the matched reuse bakeoff records a concrete unsatisfied requirement.
PAM remains methodology/config/schema/evidence state only and is not added to the Time to Crawl runtime dependency graph.
